findings.message: Acceptance criteria 6 and 7 require production admission and the full suite to pass with core_drift hard. The repository() constructor, imported through tests/test_serve.py, replaces Claude-only routing with Claude-and-Codex routing without rendering and committing AGENTS.md. The untouched-branch probe confirmed CLAUDE.md current and AGENTS.md missing after original-route adoption. This constructor is outside the scope fence.
findings.paved_road: Add tests/test_restart_timers.py to the scope fence and context, and require repository() to mechanically render and commit every conduct file selected by its replacement routing before Check or merge admission.
